name: Camping Franzlhof
beschreibung:
=== beschreibung ===

The Franzlhof Camping Ground is located in the municipality of Söll in the Tiroler Sölllandl region. The site provides pitches for RVs, caravans, and tents, along with rental caravans. Facilities include a sanitary building, waste disposal station, and a small shop. A distinctive feature is its proximity to the Söll Bergbahn lift and the town center, which offers shopping options. From here, you can enjoy hiking in the summer and skiing in the winter. The campground is ideal for activities like mountain biking or climbing in the surrounding area. The atmosphere is peaceful and tailored to campers’ needs.
